threads.body: `tox.ini` now references `tests/requirements.v2.txt`, but this PR’s diffs only show `requirements.openai-v2.txt` being edited (and no file rename/add for `requirements.v2.txt`). This will break tox with a 'file not found' when resolving deps. Fix by either adding/renaming the requirements file to `requirements.v2.txt` (preferred if that’s the new convention) or updating this path back to `requirements.openai-v2.txt`.

This comment claims the pin lives in `requirements.v2.txt`, but the PR does not show that file being added/renamed (only `requirements.openai-v2.txt` is present in the diffs). Update the comment to match the actual filename, or include the file rename/add so the comment stays accurate.
